fields.description: Binghatti Skyrise comprises three apartment towers in Business Bay, linked by a podium with leisure facilities. Studios and one- to three-bedroom homes sit below the project’s distinctive crown forms. Tower-specific plans should be matched to the selected home.

sources.label: Official linked Skyrise project facts · 8 pages; overlapping brochure

overview: The brochure lists 3,302 residential homes and 31 ground-floor shops across three towers. The residential mix comprises 2,256 studios, 996 one-bedroom, 24 two-bedroom and 26 three-bedroom homes. These are planned totals, not available units.
research.locationNote: Business Bay, Dubai. Check the chosen tower, orientation and final outlook rather than assuming every home faces the canal or Burj Khalifa.
research.priceNote: The developer hero advertises from AED 1,050,000; Property Finder labels AED 2.5m as its launch guide. Neither guide establishes an available unit across every tower or release. Obtain the selected unit’s current quotation.
research.paymentNote: The developer FAQ sets out 20% booking, 50% during construction and 30% on completion. A dated unit schedule, fees and any outstanding balance remain to be confirmed.
research.handoverNote: The developer forecasts Q4 2026; Property Finder specifies December 2026, with 31 December in its timeline. No current unit-level completion or handover confirmation was retrieved.
